evidence_type: development; repeatedly exposed historical cohort; no independent confirmation claim
features: cached 16 molecular descriptors + 6 eluent descriptors + loading-solvent PE/EA/DCM one-hot + amount + loading-solvent volume + log1p amount/volume; exact feature-only schema
probabilistic_mean: constant estimated from current authorized training labels; no supervised GNN representation in OOF
selection: Per seed only: minimum outer-OOF marginal NLPD among locally qualified GP-family×calibration candidates; if none, qualified BLR-family×calibration minimum; no cross-seed selection; identity is control; stage1 gates unchanged

qualification.aggregate: each seed and endpoint separately over its own 333 OOF rows; no labels from another outer seed influence this seed's model choice
qualification.action_if_no_model_qualified: complete all families and diagnostics; formal five-seed pair requires a locally qualified GP or registered BLR fallback for every seed; no post-hoc seed exclusion; no efficacy verdict from an unqualified posterior

targets.sampling: SHA256(seed,distribution,sample_id) nested ordering without replacement; fixed P1 per seed, P2 reindexed as U shrinks; min(M,number_available)
targets.same_input_semantics: future independent noisy label replicate; no shared observation noise with candidate

formal_training: unaltered benchmark_protocol.seed_config(smoke=False), original QGeoGNN-V2, scratch, original initialization and L333 fixed scales, validation checkpoint selection
primary_metric: combined validation NRMSE trapezoid AULC normalized by (1005-333); original nonmonotone curve
statistics: outer seed paired differences, mean, sample SD, t4 95% interval, exact paired sign permutation; no batches-as-replicates
extension_rule: after complete L1005 primary pair, extend both arms if EPIG improves mean full-window AULC OR terminal NRMSE OR late L813-1005 AULC; otherwise analyze calibration and predictor bottleneck before any registered extension amendment

compute_budget.stop: only budget, dependency/hash drift, numerical invalidity or unsafe label/state transition; never stop due to unfavorable early efficacy

calibration_definition.transform: all latent/noise/cross blocks D Sigma D; predictive mean unchanged; D finite strictly positive, no bounds or post-outcome clipping

formal_calibration_rule: each seed freezes its chosen L333 train-only cross-fitted D for the full trajectory; refit the chosen uncalibrated Gaussian surrogate on current Lt each round and apply that D to all blocks; calibration transfer across budgets is a limitation and not presumed proven
